Classes.Name: Concrete barrier Type 842
Classes.Definition: A run of Caltrans Type 842 concrete barrier: the whole whose barrier, end blocks, reinforcing and hardware are its parts.

ClassProperties.Description: The standard plan the element is built to.

Classes.Name: Concrete barrier Type 732SW
Classes.Definition: A run of Caltrans Type 732SW concrete barrier with sidewalk: the whole whose barrier, end blocks, reinforcing and hardware are its parts.

ClassProperties.Description: The standard plan the element is built to.

Classes.Name: Tubular handrailing B11-51
Classes.Definition: A run of tubular handrailing: the whole whose rails, posts, end returns, cap plates, splice sleeves and pocket mortar are its parts.

ClassProperties.Description: The standard plan the element is built to.

Classes.Name: B11-51 top rail
Classes.Definition: The continuous top rail, the member the handrailing is paid by the linear foot on. The IFC type name appends the hollow section size.

Classes.Name: B11-51 lower rail
Classes.Definition: A continuous rail below the top rail. The IFC type name appends the hollow section size.

Classes.Name: B11-51 post
Classes.Definition: A vertical post. The IFC type name appends the hollow section size.

Classes.Name: B11-51 end return
Classes.Definition: The return closing the end of a rail. The IFC type name appends the hollow section size.

Classes.Name: B11-51 rail cap plate
Classes.Definition: The plate capping an open rail end.

Classes.Name: B11-51 splice sleeve
Classes.Definition: The sleeve splicing the rail across a deck or wall joint.

Classes.Name: B11-51 post pocket mortar
Classes.Definition: The mortar filling the pocket a post is set in. Its ObjectType is "Post pocket mortar".

Classes.Name: Pipe guardrail (D90 headwall)
Classes.Definition: The pipe guardrail on top of a D90 headwall.

ClassProperties.Description: The standard plan the element is built to.

Properties.Name: Alignment
Properties.Definition: Name of the IfcAlignment the element is stationed on.

Properties.Name: StationStart
Properties.Definition: Station where the element's body starts.

Properties.Name: StationEnd
Properties.Definition: Station where the element's body ends.
Properties.Description: Property set BIMForge_LinearReference, written on every element with a body. Measured in the project length unit.

Properties.Name: StationStartText

Properties.Description: Property set BIMForge_LinearReference, written on every element with a body.

Properties.Name: StationEndText
Properties.Definition: StationEnd as station text, in StationUnit.
Properties.Description: Property set BIMForge_LinearReference, written on every element with a body.

Properties.Name: OffsetLeftMin
Properties.Definition: Smallest offset of the body from the line, positive to the left.

Properties.Name: OffsetLeftMax

Properties.Description: Property set BIMForge_LinearReference, written on every element with a body. Measured in the project length unit.

Properties.Name: OffsetText

Properties.Definition: Unit of the station and offset texts: ft or m.

Properties.Name: AnchorStation

Properties.Name: AnchorStationText
Properties.Definition: AnchorStation as station text, in StationUnit.

Properties.Name: AnchorOffsetLeft
